document.about: Infineon IRLZ44NPbF datasheet. Page 8 sets the TO-220 package's dimension table as a picture beside the package's drawing: a dimension, its minimum and maximum in millimetres, a row each, under a header three rows deep, two rows spanning both columns.

notes: 2026-11-26: the second source for the tables read from pictures' rules (see viscosity-table-set-as-picture), from another publisher. The picture's words read as one value a line. The stored reading is the built-in engine's (PP-OCRv6 small) of the page's pictures' crops, with the rules drawn in their pixels: `fdoc dev render-routed --ocr-regions --stored-resolution`, then `fdoc ocr --models`.

checks.issue: The dimension table set as a picture read as one value a line.
A guard: the package's drawing beside it, its dimension lines straight rules, is no table.
